This '''fortress''' was one of [[Dreddon]]'s bases located on a jungle planet in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was at this fortress that Dreddon was killed by [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] who was after the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] place on the Hutt's head by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Antonin]], Dreddon's rival. It was only shortly after his death that [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] arrived at the fortress to collect the bounty on Antonin that Dreddon himself had placed on the Vigo. As such, both executed their contracts effectively but resulted in neither receiving their promised pay.
